vv35:1.1: Phaḷikarajatahemajālacchannaṃ vividhavicitratalam addasaṃ surammaṃ vyamhaṃ sunimmitaṃ toraṇūpapannaṃ rucakupakiṇṇam idaṃ subhaṃ vimānaṃ. || ||
vv35:2.1: Bhāti ca dasa disā nabhe va suriyo sarade tamonudo sahassaraṃsī tathā tapati-m-idaṃ tava vimānaṃ jalam iva dhūmasikho nise nabhagge. || ||
vv35:3.1: Musatīva nayanaṃ sateratā va ākāse ṭhapitam idaṃ manuññaṃ vīṇāmurajasammatāḷaghuṭṭhaṃ iddhaṃ Indapuraṃ yathā tavedaṃ. || ||
vv35:4.1: Padumakumuduppalakuvalayaṃ yodhikabandhukanojakā ca santi sālakusumitapupphitā asokā vividhadumaggasugandhasevitam idaṃ. || ||
vv35:5.1: Saḷalalabujabhujakasaṃyuttā kusakasuphullitalatāvalambinīhi maṇijālasadisā yasassinī rammā pokkharaṇī upaṭṭhitā te. || ||
vv35:6.1: Udakaruhā ca ye 'tthi pupphajātā thalajā ye ca santi rukkhajātā mānusakā amānusakā ca dibbā sabbe tuyhaṃ nivesanamhi jātā. || ||
vv35:7.1: Kissa samadamass' ayaṃ vipāko kenāsi kammaphalen' idhūpapannā yathā ca te adhigatam idaṃ vimānaṃ tad anupadaṃ avacāsi 'lārapakhume ti. || ||
vv35:8.1: Yathā ca me adhigatam idaṃ vimānaṃ koñcamayūracakorasaṅghacaritaṃ dibbapilavahaṃsarājaciṇṇaṃ dijakāraṇḍavakokilābhinaditaṃ, || ||
vv35:9.1: Nānāsantānakapuppharukkhavividhā pāṭalijambuasokarukkhavantaṃ yathā ca me adhigatam idaṃ vimānaṃ tan te pavedissāmi suṇohi bhante. || ||
vv35:10.1: Magadhavarapuratthimena Nālakagāmo nāma atthi bhante tattha ahosiṃ pure suṇisā Sesavatī ti tattha jāniṃsu mamaṃ. || ||
vv35:11.1: Sāhaṃ apacitatthadhammakusalaṃ devamanussapūjitaṃ mahantaṃ Upatissaṃ nibbutaṃ appameyyaṃ muditamanā kusumehi abbhokiriṃ. || ||
vv35:12.1: Paramagatigatañ ca pūjayitvā antimadehadharaṃ isiṃ uḷāraṃ pahāya mānusakaṃ samussayaṃ Tidasagatā idha-m-āvasāmi ṭhānan ti. || ||
